to be traceable back to a party's cost accounting system

incurred it needs to be substantiated by some sort of
legally binding contract document or provisions, for

was a procurement process carried out that was necessary

arises from a subcontractor, was a subcontract entered
into and were the terms reasonable in the circumstances.
Has the amount been properly and reasonably incurred
with regard to the avoidance of waste and adequacy of
supervision and control, or could the expenditure have
been reasonably avoided.  Is there any duplication.

ensure that if a cost is incurred or to be incurred,
